نستقضي (form X)
# نَسْتَقْضِي (nastaqḍī) /nas.taq.dˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# نَسْتَقْضِيَ (nastaqḍiya) /nas.taq.dˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
